fields.statement: At cb21cdf1 I built rhiza with go build -trimpath, made a scratch root (rhiza root init) with projects alpha and beta (rhiza project add) and a sibling worktree alpha.feature, and drove the built binary's rhiza tui app in a tmux pane (100x30). Opened inbox, runs, autonomy, daemon and request in alpha, alpha.feature and at the root: the first line read 'Project: alpha', 'Project: alpha' and 'No project' for every app.

At cb21cdf1 I built rhiza with go build -trimpath, made a scratch root (rhiza root init) with projects alpha and beta (rhiza project add) and a sibling worktree alpha.feature, and drove the built binary's rhiza tui app in a tmux pane (100x30). In the Autonomy app opened in alpha (Plan: owner), ctrl+o showed a picker of alpha and beta; picking beta changed the header to 'Project: beta' and the form to beta's settings (Plan: auto, set earlier from the app). The Runs and Request apps switched the same way, and a request submitted after switching to beta from alpha was queued in beta (rhiza request ls in beta), not in alpha.

At cb21cdf1 I built rhiza with go build -trimpath, made a scratch root (rhiza root init) with projects alpha and beta (rhiza project add) and a sibling worktree alpha.feature, and drove the built binary's rhiza tui app in a tmux pane (100x30). Submitting the Request app opened in beta queued the request in beta only (rhiza request ls per project). Opened at the root, the app showed a Project picker first; Esc exited with nothing queued in either project; picking alpha then submitting queued the request in alpha only.

At cb21cdf1 I built rhiza with go build -trimpath, made a scratch root (rhiza root init) with projects alpha and beta (rhiza project add) and a sibling worktree alpha.feature, and drove the built binary's rhiza tui app in a tmux pane (100x30). With a blocker question landed in beta and none in alpha, the Inbox app opened in alpha listed 'beta · blocker · Blocked  Which disk holds beta's store?'. Answering it from alpha wrote Decision answer-store-q into beta, beta's inbox emptied, and alpha got no change set.

At cb21cdf1 I built rhiza with go build -trimpath, made a scratch root (rhiza root init) with projects alpha and beta (rhiza project add) and a sibling worktree alpha.feature, and drove the built binary's rhiza tui app in a tmux pane (100x30). With a live foreground run (sleep step) in each project, the Runs app in alpha and at the root listed 'alpha · Slow run in alpha' and 'beta · Slow run in beta'. The Daemon app in beta showed Pause the daemon and Run limit once, then Pause project beta and Project run limit; saving Run limit 5 and Project run limit 3 wrote rhiza.daemon.maxRuns=5 to the root's rhiza.toml and rhiza.project.maxruns=3 to beta's git config only. Setting Plan to auto in the Autonomy app (switched to beta) wrote rhiza.autonomy.plan=auto to beta's git config and nothing to alpha's.
